title: Cub Creek Foundation October 2026 Noborigama Firing
source_quote: October's Noborigama firing is approaching and we'd love you to be involved! DM Heidi for more detailed information and pricing.
evidence_sentence: Instagram posts from late August and September 2026 announce an upcoming Noborigama firing in October with open crew positions and identify two lead potters.
evidence_quote: Cub Creek Foundation is excited to have Hannah Traynham as one of our leads for this year's Noborigama firing. There's still room if anyone would like to join this wood-fire event!
summary: An October 2026 wood firing of the Noborigama kiln at Cub Creek Foundation led by Hannah Traynham and Alexandra Barao, open to outside participants who contact Heidi.
how_to_join: Contact Heidi at hkreitchet@gmail.com; DM @cubcreekfoundation on Instagram.
cost_text: Pricing available on request from Heidi.
commitment: Duration not specified; typical anagama/noborigama firing 5–7 days.
